```sql
with scoped_orders as (
    select o.order_id
    from orders o
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    join cities ci on ci.city_id = s.city_id
    where not o.is_test
      and s.region_id = 'IN-TN'
      and ci.name = 'Chennai'
      and o.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
),
tried_upi_by_bank as (
    select
        a.issuing_bank as key,
        a.order_id,
        max(case when a.status = 'captured' then 1 else 0 end) as succeeded
    from payment_attempts a
    join scoped_orders so on so.order_id = a.order_id
    where not a.is_test
      and a.method = 'upi'
    group by a.issuing_bank, a.order_id
)
select
    key,
    cast(sum(succeeded) * 1.0 / count(*) as decimal(38,12)) as value
from tried_upi_by_bank
group by key
order by value desc, key asc
limit 10
```
